analysis.reason: RSI가 과매도 구간 진입, ADX 10.7로 추세 미형성 상태. 5일 저가가 20일 저가보다 높아 Higher Low 패턴 형성 중이나, 거래량 위축으로 신뢰도 하락. 20일 이동평균선($254.64) 하향 돌파 후 저항으로 작용 중. 매수 전환은 RSI 50 이상 회복 및 거래량 증가 확인 필요.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI entered oversold territory, ADX at 10.7 indicates no trend. A Higher Low pattern is forming with the 5-day low ($245.60) above the 20-day low ($244.30), but low volume reduces confidence. The price is facing resistance below the 20-day moving average ($254.64). A shift to buy requires RSI recovery above 50 and increased volume.

[거래량·결론]

analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current price ($249.38) vs SMA5/20/50 ($253.16/$254.64/$256.18): breached short/mid-term moving averages, entering weak zone
· Position vs SMA100 ($254.64)/SMA200 ($240.73): mid-long term trend weakening, above SMA200
· 52-week position (58.5%) + current price level in historical mid-range
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (44.1→44.2) + entered oversold, staying neutral
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1.2662→-0.3988) + improving, bottoming signal
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower $245.44, Middle $254.64): approaching lower band, band width narrowing to 7.22%
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($244.30): based on 20-day low and Bollinger lower band
· Swing resistance ($249.71): based on pivot level, short-term bounce expected on breakout
· 5-day/20-day price pattern (Higher Low): recovery signal, potential trend reversal
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.78x): low confidence in price movement, subdued volume
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): maintain wait-and-see, requires RSI recovery above 50 and increased volume confirmation
